children: Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint is in talks to buy cybersecurity firm Varonis Systems, according to people familiar with the matter.
Varonis has a market value of around $5 billion. There are no guarantees a deal will come together, as talks could still fall apart or another suitor could emerge.
Updates to follow as news develops.
